newsitem.title: USA: Electronic natl gas trade system QuickTrade grows.
newsitem.headline: Electronic natl gas trade system QuickTrade grows.

text.p: The electronic natural gas trading system QuickTrade said on Wednesday that it added a 29th electronic trading post, the so-called Henry Hub in Louisiana.
QuickTrade, which was designed by Enerchange L.L.C. and Energy Exchange Inc, creates an anonymous cash market for buyers and sellers of natural gas.

"With the addition of Henry Hub, Enerchange has opened up a major new trading point for customers," Enerchange President Miles Allen said in a statement. Liquidity had improved and there were nearly 150 users throughout North America, he said.
